census.note: reached only by code, never by data; full site list in callers.tsv, reproduced by census.py

gates.name: fast_path
gates.rule: fast = gate_flag AND (byte at context+0x20 > 4, unsigned)

gates.name: tls_flag
gates.rule: tls_flag = (byte at thread-pointer - 0x10b0 > 4, unsigned); read on both paths

gates.name: fallback_zeroing
gates.rule: on the fallback path the context pointer and the gate flag are zeroed, so the observe step can never run there

gates.name: global_gate
gates.rule: the qword at 0x64ed2b0 is tested on both paths; only when nonzero is the TLS perf-level accessor (PLT _ZTHN7rocksdb10perf_levelE) called, and its return value is unused

object_layout.plus_0x30: nonzero flag; gate needs this AND a non-null context
object_layout.plus_0x38: type code (r15d); 0x34 selects the virtual-timer path

order: prologue call 0x606dd10 (no new argument registers set up; return value unused)
global gate: TLS perf-level accessor call iff the qword at 0x64ed2b0 is nonzero
begin call 0x5fe2680 with the stack record, iff fast path OR tls_flag

if the type code is 0x34 and the begin call ran: first virtual slot 0xa0 call on the TLS first-qword object, then the lock, then (only when the first result is nonzero) a second slot 0xa0 call; elapsed = second - first
if tls_flag and a nonzero first timer result: add the elapsed value to the TLS counter
if fast path and a nonzero first timer result: virtual slot 0xb0 call on the context object with (context, type code, elapsed)
otherwise (type code != 0x34, or no begin call): lock through the stub at 0x606ca00 and return

record_layout.address: rsp+0x10, passed by address to callee 0x5fe2680
record_layout.plus_0x08: filled after the begin call with the TLS first qword
record_layout.plus_0x10: zeroed after the begin call; in the timer path overwritten with the first timer result
record_layout.plus_0x20: context pointer (zero on the fallback path)

related.lock_stub: 0x606ca00 tail-jumps to the pthread lock wrapper 0x60d5230; mapped end to end in PR #2588, not re-claimed here
related.release_counterpart: the matching release path calls the unlock wrapper 0x60d52f0 (PR #2588)

transfers.cleanup_block: landing pad 0x606cc5e jumps to 0x606ca0a: if the record+0x10 slot is nonzero, dispose the record through 0x606c94c, then the stack-canary check, then _Unwind_Resume; never a normal-flow exit
internal_direct_calls: 0x606ca00 stub (the lock; two sites: normal path and timer path)
internal_indirect_calls: vtable slot 0xa0 on the TLS first-qword object (timer, twice in the timer path)
vtable slot 0xb0 on the context object (observe, fast timer path only)

unknowns: what callees 0x606dd10 and 0x5fe2680 compute internally; only their call sites, order and (for 0x5fe2680) argument are pinned
what the TLS structure at thread-pointer - 0x10b0 and the counter at thread-pointer - 0x350 + 0x1b8 denote beyond their offsets
what the virtual slot 0xa0 timer and slot 0xb0 observe callees compute; only their argument lists and order are pinned
behaviour on dangling (non-null but invalid) pointers; the model raises on a null object, stated openly
